title: Booking.com Hotel Scraper Output
description: Structured Booking.com accommodation records. Fast mode returns search-card data; detailed mode adds room options and prices, availability, meal and cancellation policies, facilities, images, descriptions, addresses, coordinates, check-in/out times, and surroundings.

results.title: Booking.com hotel records
results.description: Clean dataset items containing Booking.com hotel, price, availability, room, policy, facility, image, location, and property URL data.

summary.title: Search coverage and monitoring summary
summary.description: OUTPUT contains saved counts, failed requests, per-search coverage limits and monitoring counters. Missing results are not inferred to be sold out.
